description: The three text faces the shell draws with, by role. Each face names a source in assets/fonts/font_metrics.json (the shipped webfont plus its per-character advances), a size in game pixels, and the vertical metrics the layout uses: `ascent` is the baseline offset from the top of the line box, `descent` the room below it, and `lineHeight` the step between wrapped lines. `ui` is the 9 px chrome face, `body` the 9 px prose face and `display` the 15 px heading face. tools/build_text_faces.py bakes the fonts, the metrics table and the offline atlases from tools/sources/; tools/check_project.py measures every page layout from the same numbers.
